owner: Jeonbuk AI Data Center (JBAIDC) SPC; KT and Microsoft Korea consortium participation
notes: Jeonju City and JBAIDC signed an MOU to build and operate the Jeonbuk AI Data Center in Palbok-dong, Deokjin-gu. Planned investment is KRW 300.7 billion on an 11,599 sqm site with 9.8MW power capacity and 2027 completion target.
